name: Document Ingestion and Vector Generation Pipeline
prompt: Implement the document ingestion endpoint in FastAPI that splits input text into overlapping sliding-window chunks (target 500 characters, 50-character overlap), computes normalized dense vectors, and upserts them to the Qdrant 'documents' collection with payload metadata.

verification.criteria: Ingestion returns HTTP 201 with status 'indexed' and chunks_created >= 1
